description: Find verses tagged under a biblical topic. Use this when the user asks about a theme (e.g. "covenant", "judgment", "grace") and you want canonical examples from across Scripture. Verse text comes back in the user's conversation language by default; pass lang to override. Each verse may carry a `note: "fallback: english"` if the localized translation is missing. Outside trulyrandomverse.com/ai the default edition is the KJV ('english'); pass `lang` for another. Editions whose licence does not allow redistribution are refused. Book, chapter and verse are always KJV numbering, in every edition: the text returned is that edition's rendering of the same KJV verse. A few editions number some chapters differently in print (Ukrainian, Douay-Rheims, Geneva, Swedish and Serbian, mostly in Psalms), so a reader quoting their own Bible's number there may mean a neighbouring KJV verse.

lang.description: Optional. Internal language code. Defaults to the user's conversation language.

topic_keyword.description: Single topic word or short phrase

name: search_topic_verses
title: Find verses by topic
